{{Conjecture|legends}}
An individual was the '''right-hand''' of [[Brolla]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] though<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Working for Brolla}}</ref> by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Working for Brolla" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> they were secretly a traitor.<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> Brolla began looking for someone to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into the [[Computer/Legends|computers]] of his [[Brolla's rival|rival]]. An individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to slice into the rival's computers, which exposed Brolla's right-hand as a traitor.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Brolla's right-hand was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Crew Skill mission "Working for Brolla," though the information about the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Mission" />
